kind: first data-reading example mod in the real game

mod.what: reads 12 bytes at RVA 0x36f640 through ABI 5 and verifies their FNV-1a 64 hash

observed_events.message: info: resource path anchor verified at rva 36f640

meaning: A shipped example mod read real game bytes at a fingerprinted offset and independently recomputed the verifier's anchor hash, so the bytes provably came from the running hyperdemon.exe. 7/7 mods initialized.
content_policy: Only the hash and the RVA are recorded; the bytes themselves are never logged or committed.
limits: Read-only and build-pinned: on a patched executable build_matches() is 0 and the example reads nothing.
